definitions.explanation: Prefix indicating something or someone of notable reputation.
Prefix indicating high quality or excellence.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This temple is known as a famous place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched a film called a masterpiece.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{名采配|めいさいはい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: That manager is known for his excellent leadership.
examples.notes: {名|めい} + {采配|さいはい} = excellent management

examples.japanese: ⟦{名門|めいもん}→名門：11955_meimon⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I was accepted into a prestigious university.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名曲|めいきょく}→名曲：17476_meikyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought an album of famous songs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名医|めいい}→名医：30719_meii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{診|み}て→診る：09798_miru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I was seen by an excellent doctor.

notes:
⟦{名|めい}→〜名：04015_mei⟧〜 is a prefix meaning 'famous' or 'excellent.'

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧ (famous place; scenic spot)
- ⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧ (masterpiece)
- ⟦{名人|めいじん}→名人：03753_meijin⟧ (master; expert)
- ⟦{名物|めいぶつ}→名物：05591_meibutsu⟧ (famous product; specialty)
- ⟦{名曲|めいきょく}→名曲：17476_meikyoku⟧ (famous piece of music)
- ⟦{名言|めいげん}→名言：20185_meigen⟧ (famous saying; wise words)
- ⟦{名門|めいもん}→名門：11955_meimon⟧ (distinguished family; prestigious school)
- ⟦{名医|めいい}→名医：30719_meii⟧ (famous doctor)
- ⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧ (business card) - note: different meaning

SIMILAR PREFIX:
⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な (famous) is an adjective, while ⟦{名|めい}→〜名：04015_mei⟧〜 is a prefix that attaches directly.

USAGE:
⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧ (business card) uses the kanji ⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧ for 'name' rather than 'famous.'
